provenance: All numeric values are design constants fixed before any experiment in this repository was run. One rule (not a value) was changed after the first ablation: an uncorroborated HIGH now also requires the current smoothed visual score to reach vision_high (docs/design/policy-design.md). None was fitted to MVTec AD test images, to the workload ground truth or to the sensitivity sweep (results/sensitivity), which only describes how results change around these values. Visual scores are normalized per category so that the 99th percentile of held-out nominal *training* distances maps to 0.5 (scripts/build_score_bank.py).

cross_modal_divergence.meaning: |v_ema - s_ema| above which unconfirmed evidence is routed to review

window_size_n.meaning: window length in frames (333 ms at 30 FPS)

cooldown_steps.meaning: quiet frames that close an incident (500 ms at 30 FPS)

alpha_sensor.meaning: EMA factor for the composite sensor score
